closed_lines.line: four-factor agreement additive to C sleeve
four-factor agreement hard gate on C candidates

known_limitations: Common window starts 2022-05-05 because TTM C-sleeve data starts then.
Agreement is derived from the same four factors and is not independent data.
Industry classification uses a current snapshot backfilled through history.
ETF qfq caches are not official PIT total-return series.
The gate minimum of one candidate per day implies sparse-day concentration risk.
next_research_guidance: Do not scan the agreement threshold, additive weight, component set or C cap.
The gate shows the trade-off: it can improve the 2022 tail but destroys C-sleeve net alpha.
Next work must find an independent return source or a portfolio structure that increases 5x net-profit breadth, not another reweighting of the same four factors.
